presentation.overview: Airwindows ToTape9: tape saturation with Dolby-style tilt, bias, flutter and head bump.

Play softly, then hard. Listen for changes in tape colour and drive.

controls.name: Input
controls.doc: Input drive: 50 = unity, 100 = 4x into tape. Above unity, automatic compensation reduces level lift; Output independently trims the wet signal. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Tilt
controls.doc: Dolby-style encode/decode balance: sets pre-emphasis against de-emphasis, which drives both tape drive and the wet/dry blend. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Shape
controls.doc: Weights how much of Tilt's encode vs decode lands (0.35..1.0 each way). Subtle by construction, and it was invisible while the x7.14 scaling pinned it. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Flutr
controls.doc: Airwindows D. Flutter depth in samples at 44.1 kHz. Range 0–100.

controls.name: FlSpd
controls.doc: Airwindows E. Flutter sweep speed. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Bias
controls.doc: Asymmetric even-harmonic drive: biased = x + k*x^2, k bipolar around centre. The k curve is quartic below centre and cubic above, so the distortion character genuinely changes at different points of travel rather than just getting louder. Range 0–100.

controls.name: HBump
controls.doc: Low-frequency head-bump resonance amount; frequency fixed near 60 Hz in the active full kernel. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Out
controls.doc: Wet output trim 0..2x, unity at 50, after automatic input-drive compensation and before Mix. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Mix
controls.doc: Dry/wet crossfade. Renamed from 'Output' so every effect in the pack ends with the same control. Range 0–100.

limitations: Hardware untested on the original MS-70CDR with OS 2.10.
This build has startup knob initialization disabled. Check saved settings after recalling a patch.
